Strategy: Item-scaled leave-room bonus: add a bonus equal to the item size whenever placing it still leaves at least one item-sized gap in the bin, otherwise score by tightest fit; this steers items into bins that stay reusable for a same-size item instead of nearly closing a bin. It can fail when it systematically avoids closing bins, leaving many half-open bins.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [(-(r - item) + (item if r - item >= item else 0)) for r in bins]
```
